overview: This paper proposes IGPO, a reinforcement learning framework for masked diffusion large language models that leverages inpainting with partial ground-truth hints to solve the zero-advantage dilemma in group-based policy optimization, alongside a Length-Aligned SFT method using rewritten concise traces for better initialization.

modules.name: Reasoning Trace Rewriting Pipeline
modules.description: Process and rewrite verbose reasoning traces into concise, structured forms that align with the generation budget constraints of masked dLLMs, preparing data for Length-Aligned SFT.

modules.name: Hint Chunking & Injection Strategy
modules.description: Segment ground-truth reasoning traces into variable-length contiguous chunks and construct binary masks to identify positions for hint injection during the inpainting process.

modules.name: Masked dLLM Inpainting Sampler
modules.description: Implement the iterative denoising generation loop for masked dLLMs that accepts fixed hint tokens as context and generates completions for masked positions via bidirectional attention.

modules.name: DiffuGRPO Probability Estimator
modules.description: Estimate token-level log probabilities and sequence-level likelihoods for the masked diffusion policy using mean-field approximation to enable tractable importance ratio and reverse-KL calculations.

modules.name: IGPO Elastic Sampler & Batch Constructor
modules.description: Detect zero-advantage scenarios (all-wrong groups), trigger inpainting generation with variable hint ratios, verify correctness of inpainted samples, and construct the augmented RL batch by replacing incorrect samples with verified correct ones.

modules.name: Entropy-based Gradient Filter
modules.description: Compute token-level entropy for injected hint positions and selectively apply gradient masking to restrict policy updates to only the high-entropy hint positions where the model is uncertain.

modules.name: IGPO Loss Function
modules.description: Compute the clipped surrogate objective using group-relative advantages and reverse-KL regularization on the augmented batch, integrating the entropy-based gradient filtering for stability.

modules.name: Length-Aligned SFT Trainer
modules.description: Execute the supervised fine-tuning phase on the length-aligned concise reasoning traces to provide a strong initialization for the subsequent reinforcement learning stage.

modules.name: Reward Verification Module
modules.description: Extract final numerical answers from the generated reasoning traces and compare them against ground truth to assign binary rewards for policy optimization.

modules.name: Benchmark Evaluator
modules.description: Evaluate model performance across mathematical reasoning benchmarks using specific sampling temperatures, generation lengths, and aggregation metrics like pass@1 and avg@16.

modules.name: Ablation & Robustness Framework
modules.description: Define experimental configurations for analyzing the impact of partial vs. full hint injection, entropy filtering thresholds, and robustness to noisy ground-truth reasoning traces.

modules.name: Training Orchestrator
modules.description: Manage the end-to-end training loop, coordinating the interaction between the elastic sampler, probability estimator, reward module, and optimizer, while handling checkpointing and logging.
